> I would use a `LocalVector` here, `PackedStringArray` is only meant when using APIs that interface with Variant / method bindings.

BTW that's the reason for what you noticed:

> I checked across the codebase and didn't see `PackedStringArray` used with `std::initializer_list<String>` even a single time in production code. Is there a reason?
Should this comment maybe just point to this PR too? Or maybe replace all comments pointing to this PR with a `*` and say `* = synced with ...`

I pointed to this PR and added the period according to the comment style guide
Comment is now `// GH-104154 (fpsmon).`
I propose reverting this one in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/104592 as this layer is actually useful, and so far we're not aware of it causing problems for Godot.
